record.title: Prepare and independently control the matched-policy RF controller
record.intent: Turn the reviewable arm proposal into frozen tested eligibility, reduction and transition controls.
requirements: Freeze the proposed A1 stock, B derived, A2 stock schedule with five repeats at100,800,975,1000,100MHz per arm; use identical original-volts AC RMS, one default receive receipt per record and separate strict hard eligibility. Preserve all earlier byte sequences and protocols.

Test full100k/count1/start1/stop100k/rate4G/250ps geometry, strict180mV extrema and360mV Vpp upper limits; allow only named low-floor range rejection or receive-stage band-peak-frequency/global-peak-frequency/energy-fraction failures under a separately frozen interpretation for every arm. Exact zero has no invented finite dB ratio and unavailable return ratios make the decision unassessable.

Test all50 B-to-A pair comparisons at1GHz for positive or contrary1dB contrast; all comparisons must pass the same direction. Enforce0.3dB A2/A1 returns at100,800,975,1000, eacharm100MHz return and pairwise initial100MHz anchors; no drift correction, replacement slots, missing-arm inference or mixed fit/RMS metrics.

Prepare a fresh configurable controller and independent transition verifier. Revalidate introduced native file ancestry, actual package path, hash, ownership, map geometry, boot/process identity, four fixed policy reads16bytes, signedAPK, options and protected logical corpus before each transition. Do not reuse the old recovery rollback path as a healthy-transition gate.

Freeze one normal reboot per transition with no retransmission after ambiguous delivery; one bounded postboot adbd-root request only if needed for the established read-only observer, no remount or policy changes. Require changed bootID, fresh isolated lease, normal visible UI, strict preservation and more than1800seconds health-serviced warmup after each reboot. Do not begin a transition unless the remaining sequence and cleanup fit the03:56UTC deadline.

Independently exercise altered-source/state/geometry/claim controls, UI/capture/lease/deadline failures and partial-run preservation. Use typed Python with no Any, frozen named Pydantic outcomes, strict type/lint/format checks; stock inputs and reusable receive/statistics modules remain unchanged. Commit and push preparation before physical execution.
acceptance: A frozen tested controller supports one bounded healthy stock rollback and the declared comparison or records an exact preparation blocker.
